parameters.jsCode: const zone = 'America/Sao_Paulo'; const now = new Date(); const dateParts = Object.fromEntries(new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', { timeZone: zone, year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit' }).formatToParts(now).filter((part) => part.type !== 'literal').map((part) => [part.type, part.value])); const dayKey = `${dateParts.year}-${dateParts.month}-${dateParts.day}`; const state = $getWorkflowStaticData('node'); if (state.static_message_day !== dayKey) { state.static_message_day = dayKey; state.static_message_sequence = 0; } state.static_message_sequence = Number(state.static_message_sequence || 0) + 1; const sequence = state.static_message_sequence; const msgId = `msg_${String(sequence).padStart(3, '0')}`; return [{ json: { run_id: `${dayKey}-${msgId}-static`, execution_day: dayKey, sequence, msg_id: msgId, root_folder_name: 'ofertas-femininas', profile: 'feminino', marketplace: 'google-drive', target: 'grupo-ofertas-feminino', target_chat_id: '120363412864266334@g.us', allowed_targets: ['grupo-ofertas-feminino'], channel_adapter: 'whatsapp', manifest_item_number: sequence, artifact_generated_at: `${dayKey}T03:00:00.000Z`, manifest_created_at: now.toISOString(), planned_at: now.toISOString(), static_ready: true, delivery_status: 'cancelled', sent_at: null } }];
